== Overview ==

Tibiara is a real map old school gaming server with nostalgic worlds for classic Tibia 7.4 and 8.0 gameplay. This wording comes from the recorded official website metadata.

Players searching for '''Tibiara''' usually want the official website, client download path, rules, rates, and whether the world is still active. See:
